response.sql: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS average_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), compared AS (SELECT team_id, average_wins, average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses, average_wins - AVG(average_wins) OVER () AS wins_above_team_mean FROM team_averages) SELECT team_id, average_wins, average_games_minus_losses_divided_by_losses, wins_above_team_mean FROM compared WHERE wins_above_team_mean > 0 ORDER BY wins_above_team_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
